data.description:
## Observation
- Gerrit change 3335 (Release 0.15.0, a version-only change) got Verified -1 on 2026-11-09 at 14:00 PST. Run 42702801672: all 7 `bounded mutation gate` shards fail with `baseline-test: head/<shard>: selected clean tests failed`. Every pytest, lint, typecheck, artifact-probe and optionality job passed.
- The shard artifact `head-clean.txt` (gates shard) shows the clean baseline erroring on its first test: pytest's rm_rf of `--basetemp` fails with `OSError: [Errno 16] Device or resource busy: '/tmp/rebar-mutation-*/gates-head/.mutation-pytest'`, then `tmp_path_factory.mktemp` raises `FileExistsError: [Errno 17]` on the same path (tests/conftest.py:609). No mutant ran.
- Mechanism: `execute_shard` (scripts/mutation_gate.py) passes `sandbox_allow = (root, basetemp)`, and `_bwrap_argv` (scripts/mutation_sandbox.py) turns each entry into `--bind <path> <path>`. Inside the namespace `.mutation-pytest` is then a mount point, which pytest's basetemp setup cannot delete and recreate.
- Working comparison: run 41939410124 (change 3328, 2026-11-04 16:11 PST) passed all 7 shards on runner image ubuntu-24.04, where bwrap 0.9.0 reported `setting up uid map: Permission denied`, so the gate ran UNSANDBOXED under REBAR_MUTATION_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED=1. Run 42702801672 ran on ubuntu-26.04 (every job in the run), where bwrap 0.11.1 creates the namespace, so the sandboxed path executed in CI for the first time.

## Impact
Every patch set whose selector picks a mutation shard now gets Verified -1. A version bump changes pyproject.toml and uv.lock, which select all 7 shards, so no release can land: Release 0.15.0 (impeccable-deserved-shrew, change 3335) is blocked on this. A recheck is not a remedy; the failure is deterministic on ubuntu-26.04.

## Unverified
Not reproduced locally (macOS has no bwrap; the seatbelt path is separate). The EBUSY-on-bind-mount mechanism is read from code and the CI artifact, not exercised in a Linux namespace here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The mutation gate's clean baseline passes under a working bwrap sandbox, for example by binding a parent directory writable and passing pytest a basetemp beneath it, with a test that runs the bwrap argv shape against a bind-mounted basetemp.
- [ ] [non-codebase] A Verified run on ubuntu-26.04 that selects all 7 shards passes them.
      provenance: environment=GitHub Actions navapbc/rebar ubuntu-26.04 runners; principal=CI GITHUB_TOKEN; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read from the Verified run's mutation shard conclusions
data.title: Mutation gate fails every shard on ubuntu-26.04: bwrap bind-mounts pytest basetemp, so clean baseline hits EBUSY/EEXIST
